scheme_name: West Bengal Migrant Workers’ Welfare Scheme: Cremation
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal
Applicant must be ordinarily a worker employed or likely to be employed in any State/UT other than West Bengal or outside India
Beneficiary must be the nominee nominated by the registered migrant worker
The migrant worker must have died during the course of employment at the workplace or place of stay
Registration and claim must be processed through the KARMASATHI (PARIJAYEE SHRAMIK) mobile app
Registered migrant workers must renew their registration on a yearly basis
benefits_summary: A financial assistance of ₹3,000 is provided to the nominee of a deceased registered migrant worker for cremation.
